uses.anchor: How to declare and reference AI in your assessments (if permitted)

uses.quote: The tools are not a fool proof or fully reliable sources, and they should never be treated as such.

default_when_silent.quote: The general position is that you can use Artificial Intelligence (AI) but must follow any requirements set out in assessments and course handbooks.

decided_by.quote: Your module tutor/leader decides what is ‘appropriate’ for each module assessment.
Whether AI is permitted, and if so, how you can use it, will be outlined in each of your assessment briefs or course handbook.

duty.quote: You will be required to state if any AI has been used as part of the submission procedure.

contents.quote: If you use an AI, you must set out why, where and how you have done so - this may be done with a clear paragraph in your submission.

location.quote: Include a short paragraph in your assignment submission explaining how you've used it.

records.quote: Record interactions with any AI that you later use or rely upon for a submission.

referencing.quote: Check your course handbook, department's webpages or assessment brief for referencing guidance.

consequence.quote: Failing to honestly acknowledge your use of AI in could be considered academic misconduct.
